parameters.message:
=

Added to Waitlist

Dear {{ $json.user_name || 'Valued Customer' }},

Your original provider cancelled but unfortunately we could not find an available slot with an alternative provider for {{ $json.booking_date }}.

Booking Details:

Booking ID: {{ $json.original_booking_id }}
Service: {{ $json.service_type }}
Location: {{ $json.location }}

You have been added to our waitlist and we will notify you as soon as a slot opens up.

Sincerely,
The GharFix Team
